cond_0001.intro: The main function of this role is to accurately input sample data to the Laboratory Information Management System. This position is in a microbiology lab that is projected to process more than 85,000 samples this year.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Job Responsibilities:
Primary – High volume data entry of customer and sample information into LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System). File and retrieve corporate documents, records, and reports. Open, sort and distribute incoming correspondence, including email and phone messages. Prepare responses to correspondence containing routing inquiries. Light laboratory tasks such as storing and disposal of completed samples.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Attention to detail to ensure that customer and sample information is entered accurately.
Prior data entry experience.
High data entry speed and accuracy due to time-sensitive nature of the laboratory samples.
Good spelling.
Ability to work independently and manage one's time.
Ability to keep information organized and confidential.
Preferred Requirements:
Verbal and written communication skills, multi-tasking, customer service skills and interpersonal skills.
Previous experience with computer applications, such as Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
Team player and detail oriented.
Environment:
Candidate will be performing office-based work in a lab environment. Seeking a candidate who is comfortable with exposure to the lab. Candidates who have performed data entry/clerical in a lab or plant environment previously may be a good fit.

Lab work will be assigned as possible when data entry tasks are complete.
